candidate.answerReason: Eight tenths of 50 yuan is 50 × 0.8 = 40 yuan.

methods.label: Multiply by the decimal discount
methods.levelReason: The method uses the Grade 6 discount meaning and previously learned decimal-by-integer multiplication.

methods.label: Find one tenth first
methods.explanation: Eight tenths means taking 8 of 10 equal shares of the original price. One share costs \(50\div10=5\) yuan, so 8 shares cost \(5\times8=40\) yuan. The discounted price is 40 yuan.
methods.levelReason: Equal sharing and multiplication facts give a complete primary-school route without decimal multiplication.
